lines.label: B1

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Side tab with two holes (patches 2/9), a 90 deg fold. The outer apex is hit at 25/50/75%, with the nearest point about 0.05 mm away. The tab spans about -0.3 to 14.8 mm and the line covers 0 to 14.57 mm.

missing_bends: B4 (missing): about 10.7 deg bend from the plate's top skin (patch 2) down to the end panel (patches 5/6, on the side away from B1, about 7.8 mm deep). The angle between the patch 2 and patch 6 normals is 10.73 deg. Local slope fits give 10.6-11.0 deg at the 25/50/75% stations. The transition is centred at the same place at all three stations, so the crease is straight. It runs across the full panel width of about 18.5 mm (panel t 0.5-19.0). Both sides are flat planes (rms about 0.005-0.009 mm). The transition is about 4-5 mm long, which fits a shallow press-brake air bend rather than a random rolled distortion. The crease is also visible as a crisp fold in the existing closeup_B3 face-on render. The original labeller excluded it only because it was under the old 15 deg rule. Under the 2026-10-18 rule (>= 10 deg counts) it should be a line on the convex top skin (patches 2/6 side), apex near the middle of the transition. The legacy count of 4 matches 3 + this bend. Caveat: it is only 0.7 deg over the threshold, and it holds only if the owner does not class it as a 'gentle rolled kink'.
